tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain's live DNS and grade its email authentication: DMARC, SPF, DKIM (common selectors), MX, BIMI and MTA-STS. Returns each record, its status and the issues found, with a guide link per issue. A domain checked in the last few minutes is answered from that check (cached, with its age); p

tools.name: generate_spf_record
tools.description: Build an SPF TXT record from the services and servers that send email for a domain, with an estimate of the DNS lookups it uses against SPF's limit of 10. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

tools.name: generate_dmarc_record
tools.description: Build a DMARC TXT record and the host to publish it at, from a policy and the addresses that should receive aggregate reports. Notes what the record does not cover yet. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?utm_source=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain · Private data: check_domain, generate_spf_record, generate_dmarc_record · Public sink: check_domain, generate_spf_record, generate_dmarc_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain · Private data: check_domain, generate_spf_record, generate_dmarc_record · Public sink: check_domain, generate_spf_record, generate_dmarc_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
